review_object.scope: Procedural repetition of two canonical lexical query strings in native arXiv search UI; bounded abstract screening.

status.final_delivery_cutoff_refresh: Native UI observations dated 2026-11-18 only; no claim about an unspecified later delivery cutoff.

method.tool_provenance: Both native arXiv HTML search URLs returned bibliographic content; the web tool labeled both 'Crawled: today'. This is a new tool request and observation, not an independently attested arXiv backend HTTP transaction timestamp. No cached tool content was invented or inferred.
method.navigation: Direct native UI search URL with unquoted lexical query, searchtype=all, abstracts=show, descending announced date, 50 results per page.
method.distinction: The canonical lexical strings are unchanged. Native UI headings are reported literally. The historical API requests prepended all: and the stored feed explicitly expands terms using OR. UI and API counts therefore cannot measure growth or deletions.
method.bounded_inspection: Q2 ranks 1-2 and Q5 ranks 1-4 were deliberately examined by title and complete abstract as exposed by the tool. The Q5 first-page heading advertises 50 results; only the first four are screened here. No paper bodies were opened.
method.evidence_retention: Retain request URLs, observed headings, line locators, identifiers, short paraphrases, and decisions; do not claim a full HTML/raw network archive.
